projects.name: Signal Garden

estimate.label: Phone audio and swipe repairs live

projects.blurb: Compose music that grows a living, readable landscape.
projects.current_work: Background audio now uses pre-rendered buffers, with no late chunks or gaps in the sixfold CPU-throttled check. Smooth strip swiping and hold-drag editing are live.
projects.next_checkpoint: Ready for a real-phone recheck when you return.
projects.limitation: Real phone screen-off behavior remains unverified.

projects.name: Tidal Archive
projects.blurb: A narrative exploration game set in a drowning city.
projects.current_work: The owner has playtested it once and wants to play it again before giving feedback.
projects.next_checkpoint: Iterate on the owner's feedback after the re-playtest.

projects.current_work: The owner has playtested it once and wants to play it again before giving feedback.
projects.next_checkpoint: Iterate on the owner's feedback after the re-playtest.

projects.name: Event Horizon
projects.blurb: Fly close to a black hole and come home to people who kept living.
projects.current_work: Your interface requests are live (burn plan, full-length strip, pannable map, plain labels, step-by-step reveals, fine steps, quiet mail). Missions 5 and 6 now carry real home-clock stakes with Ruth and Pip.
projects.next_checkpoint: Replay from mission 1, or jump to missions 5 and 6 for the new stakes, and tell us what still confuses.
projects.limitation: Mission 7 is unchanged; the late-mission choices are measured and tested but not yet played by a person.
projects.milestone: Interface repairs; next mission update agreed

projects.name: Foldsmith+

estimate.label: Private AI helper connected and ready to try

projects.blurb: A papercraft workshop: pick a model, watch it fold, print the kit.
projects.current_work: The hosted helper is enabled with a private access token and a persistent total spending cap. One real generated design passed geometry and print checks.
projects.next_checkpoint: Try a small custom design, inspect its assembly steps, and test a printed model. Handwritten examples remain available without access.
projects.limitation: The free server may need about a minute to wake. Broader generated design quality and physical fabrication still need human feedback.

projects.name: Impossible Rooms

estimate.label: Targeted window repair live; visual recheck needed

projects.blurb: Architecture that cannot exist, explored in first person.
projects.current_work: Independent traversal reached five of seven lanterns. The reproduced window defect has a targeted repair; build and geometry checks pass.
projects.next_checkpoint: Check the distant round window from the wardrobe and continue the unfinished traversal when convenient.
projects.limitation: Memory guards prevented the matching after-repair screenshot. Stairs and Heart were not reached in the blind run; physical mouse feel remains unverified.
projects.milestone: Some visual fixes live; recursion repair active

projects.name: Worldseed
projects.blurb: Watch life evolve across branching histories of a seeded world.
projects.current_work: Creatures vary more in colour, markings, coat and proportions; each biome has its own light and plants; you can walk into the sea; drawing cost per creature fell about 12x. Live locally on port 5197.
projects.next_checkpoint: Owner playtest, plus a re-run of the GPU fps page to confirm the first-flip stutter is gone.
projects.limitation: The stutter fix is verified only in software rendering so far.

projects.name: Afterimage

estimate.label: Afterimage revealed and ready to play

projects.blurb: One courtyard across a century: gather testimony, change the past, and decide what to tell Maya about the bell.
projects.current_work: The independent ending check, evidence-boundary repairs, save and reopen and readable export checks passed.
projects.next_checkpoint: Explore the courtyard across eras, collect evidence and revisit the consequences of your choices.
projects.limitation: The latest independent route covered one ending; other eras, accounts and physical-device feel still need your feedback.

projects.name: Glyphcraft
projects.blurb: Decode a mountain keeper's script, answer in it, then make the script your own and export a real font.
projects.current_work: The independent author session and export inspection passed. Navigation repairs and a readable accepted-work preview are verified and merged.
projects.limitation: Physical device behavior and installed export use remain unverified.

projects.name: Surveyor

estimate.label: Surveyor revealed and ready to play

projects.blurb: Survey a landscape by eye, draw the map, and send a courier to walk it; their notes tell you where your map was wrong.
projects.current_work: All three expeditions are implemented. The final independent delivery and save and reopen succeeded; the report layout repair passed three screen sizes.
projects.next_checkpoint: Start at Windbreak Ridge, make your field sheet and send Oriel along your own route.
projects.limitation: The final run completed one expedition; an earlier task was interrupted. Natural full-journey transfer and physical-device feel remain unverified.

projects.name: Automata
projects.blurb: Draw motion and build hand-cranked mechanical sculptures.
projects.current_work: Port 5198 has persistent camera positioning, Front, Side and Top views, steadier panels, restored examples and clearer timing. The latest agent checks passed.
projects.limitation: Real GPU feel and timing remain for the user to assess.

projects.name: Parlour

estimate.label: Hosted multiplayer ready for device playtest

projects.blurb: Two party games for a TV and phones: a memory game about invented details, and a co-op patent office.
projects.current_work: The approved online game is open. Private live updates, reconnect and a real hosted restart passed; saved reports and seats survived.
projects.next_checkpoint: Play with a host screen and separate player devices, then report any game-flow or connection issues.
projects.limitation: Free hosting may take about a minute to wake. Physical multi-device playtesting remains.
